channel.title: WisdomAI Blog
channel.description: Comprehensive feed of all WisdomAI blog posts (41 items).

item.title: Agent and Harness Design Lessons from WisdomAI
item.description: What DeepSeek, Apple, and Netflix taught us about building AI agents, and the results co-designing delivers in analytics.

item.title: Connect WisdomAI in Claude
item.description: Now your team can keep asking questions right where they already work, and every answer comes back accurate, governed, and grounded in your business context.

item.title: Four Questions to Ask When You Interview at a Startup
item.description: So you landed a job interview? Congrats! Here are four questions you should ask to actually interview the startup instead of them just interviewing you.

item.title: From 93% to 100% Accuracy: The Last Mile of AI Analytics
item.description: One question, two right answers. See how one team used a context development lifecycle to take its AI analytics evaluation set from 94% to 100%.

item.title: Building the Benchmark: WisdomAI vs. Claude Code
item.description: Frozen questions, executed SQL, 3 runs per question. Get the methodology behind the benchmark and learn how to run the test on your data.

item.title: Introducing Live Apps: The Live App I use to run WisdomAI
item.description: WisdomAI CEO Soham Mazumdar gives an inside look into the Live App he uses every day.

item.title: A Day in the Life of a SQL Query
item.description: Join WisdomAI Co-Founder and Chief Architect, Guilherme Menezes, as he unpacks why SQL generation is harder than it looks.

item.title: Reflections on Growing to 100 Employees
item.description: We recently hired our 100th employee. To celebrate this major milestone, WisdomAI Director of Ops and People reflects on the past few years.

item.title: AI Readiness is Not the Same as Data Cleanliness
item.description: CPO Kapil Chhabra reflects on new research from over 200 enterprise leaders. See why context, not clean data, is the real key to trustworthy AI analytics.

item.title: WisdomAI Hackathon 2026: Highlights and Recap
item.description: WisdomAI Hackathon 2026 just wrapped. See what our engineering and dev teams built over 48 hours — solving real user friction.

item.title: Introducing WisdomAI Analytics Agents
item.description: Meet the WisdomAI Analytics Agents. With autonomous workflows that reason across your data stack, you can bridge the gap between insight and action.

item.title: Announcing WisdomAI's Partnership with Teradata
item.description: Now your team can use WisdomAI Agentic Analytics directly in Teradata AI Studio. Go from governed data to action with conversational BI and enterprise context.

item.title: What it actually takes to make AI analytics work on your data
item.description: Most AI analytics tools lack a managed and governed approach to enterprise context. Our latest launches make agentic analytics attainable and efficient.

item.title: Data Innovators: Tal Shaked
item.description: Everything in AI is a Quality Problem" with Tal Shaked, Chief ML Officer (CMLO), Moloco

item.title: Data Innovators: An Interview with Alla Ivanova - ex-Google Looker
item.description: Ex-Google Looker Data Innovator Alla Ivanova shares her perspectives on teh evolving role of AI and data in business,

item.title: Our Comprehensive Guide on Conversational BI for Teams and Businesses
item.description: Discover how conversational BI helps teams turn data into instant insights. See its key benefits, real-world use cases, and how to get started with WisdomAI.

item.title: Announcing our $50M Series A funding led by Kleiner Perkins
item.description: WisdomAI secured $50 million in Series A funding, led by Kleiner Perkins, to advance its AI Data Analysts and autonomous AI Agents, shifting analytics from static dashboards to proactive, context-aware insights.
